subject: Request: Onramp support + one-time credits for Aerolith Systems
messages:
From: Sam Park <sam.park@aerolithsys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Help with credits and trial extension — Aerolith onramp

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We started ingesting data this week but hit a few unexpected blockers on our side (formatting and S3 access delays). Because of that, our usage for the initial trial week is much lower than we expected.

Two asks:
- Can Redwood provide a small one-time credit top-up so we don’t run out of trial capacity while we fix ingest?
- Can we get a 2–3 week trial extension and a short onboarding session with an engineer to help unblock the ETL?

If we can get those, we’re prepared to accelerate an internal POC and talk about a 6–12 month committed plan (we’re targeting a pilot in Q3). Appreciate any flexibility you can offer — budget and procurement timelines are tight for us.

Attached: aerolith_usage_q2.csv (sample usage & error logs).

Best,
Sam
Sam Park
Head of ML Engineering
Aerolith Systems
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@aerolithsys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Help with credits and trial extension — Aerolith onramp

Sam —

Thanks for the context and the upload, that helps. Short answer: we can structure a small, time‑bounded concession to keep momentum.

Proposed short package (subject to internal approval):
- One-time trial credit: $8,000 applied within 48 hours
- Trial extension: +3 weeks from when you’re ready to resume testing
- Dedicated 2‑hour onboarding session with an engineer (screen share + ETL review)

Before I push this through, can you confirm:
1) Rough steady-state TPS/requests per minute when you hit production (ballpark is fine)
2) Target contract length if the pilot looks good (6/12 months?)

Looping Ben (sales ops) for a quick cost check and Naomi for CS scheduling.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@aerolithsys.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Help with credits and trial extension — Aerolith onramp

Thanks Marissa / Sam. I reviewed their usage snapshot. The proposed $8k credit + 3 weeks onboarding is doable but crosses the Sales Ops threshold for one-off concessions > $5k. For anything above $10k we need Exec approval (Vivek or Aditya).

Quick estimate: if they convert to a 6‑month commit at the expected pilot scale, this could be a $120k ARR account. Risk is moderate because ETL issues are internal to Aerolith.

Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@aerolithsys.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Exec approval request — Aerolith one-time credits + onboarding (DEAL-9837)

Vivek / Aditya —

Request: approval for a combined concession to secure Aerolith Systems as a pilot customer. Details below.

Why this matters:
- Upside: projected ARR ~$120k if pilot converts to scale.
- Competitive risk: they’re evaluating two other vendors and have limited internal bandwidth; momentum is time-sensitive.
- History: long-standing relationship with their CTO — decision can move quickly if we remove the immediate blockers.

Proposed concession (one-time, non-recurring):
- $12,000 one-time trial credit applied to their test account
- 4 weeks additional trial from their ‘ready’ date
- Dedicated onboarding: up to 8 hours of engineering time across two sessions
- Follow-on commercial incentive: 15% discount on first 6 months if they sign a 6‑month minimum commitment within 60 days

Conditions we’d like attached:
1) They sign our MOA (attached: moa_draft_aerolith_v1.pdf) before credits are applied.
2) Legal to review the MOA (simple SOW + credit terms).
3) Clear success criteria (engineer sign-off) after onboarding.

Attachments: proposed_onramp_package.pdf, moa_draft_aerolith_v1.pdf

Asking for a greenlight or a counter from you both. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk through the economics.

Thanks,
Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@aerolithsys.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Aerolith one-time credits + onboarding (DEAL-9837)

Marissa —

Appreciate the summary. A couple quick clarifying points before I approve:
- Condition the full $12k credit on signed MOA (Marissa noted this; important). If Legal flags anything, cap the immediate credit to $10k and hold the remaining $2k pending MOA signature.
- Require a minimum commercial commitment: at least $50k ARR over the first 6 months or the credits are clawed back against first invoice.
- Confirm we have a named CSM and timelines for the onboarding sessions (Naomi pls confirm availability).

If these are acceptable, you have my provisional approval. Final sign-off after Legal confirms MOA language.

—Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales & Customer Growth
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@aerolithsys.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Exec approval request — Aerolith one-time credits + onboarding (DEAL-9837)

Sam —

Good news: Vivek has provided provisional approval. High‑level outcome and next steps:

Approved (conditional):
- Immediate credit release: $10,000 applied once Legal confirms receipt of the MOA draft.
- Holdback: remaining $2,000 to be applied after MOA signed and success criteria confirmed.
- Trial extension: +3 weeks from your go‑live test date.
- Onboarding: Naomi will schedule two sessions (up to 8 hours total) next week.
- Commercial condition: minimum $50k ARR over first 6 months or credits will be recouped against initial invoices.

Next steps for Aerolith:
1) Please review the attached MOA draft (moa_draft_aerolith_v1.pdf) and provide any redlines via DocuSign or back to me.
2) Confirm a preferred window for onboarding (Naomi will follow up).
3) Confirm expected steady‑state RPS/TPS so we can size Dedicated support if needed.

Ben / Naomi / Vivek — I’ll coordinate Legal and follow up when we have a signed MOA. Sam, thanks for the quick turnaround — excited to get you past the ingest issues.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
